title: QUESTIONNAIRES — Medical History
description: Doctor-told iron levels, symptoms, pica, iron supplements, restless legs, breathlessness, difficulty walking and medication items from the questionnaire.
$comment: Items carry the source's own codes: 998 = not applicable on the restless-legs follow-up items (universe not stated, D011), and a plain '999 = don't know' (no 'prefer not to answer') on some items, inlined with the source's own label.
